censys.no_key: Censys access token missing: module not applicable
censys.not_public: Non-public address: Censys not applicable (no third-party service queried)
censys.unreadable: Unreadable response from the Censys service
module.censys.checks: Queries the Censys platform for the target IP address: indexed services and software, labels, certificates and autonomous system.
module.censys.fix:
Compare the services, software, labels and certificates that Censys indexes on the address with your inventory: any unexpected service or port must be closed right away in the firewall (see the "Open ports" module), starting with databases, remote administration and APIs without authentication.
If a sensitive service appears without protection, close it first, then treat it as compromised: change its passwords, keys and tokens, read its logs.
List what really listens on the server (snippets below) to find the service behind each Censys line: anything listening on `0.0.0.0` or `[::]` is reachable from anywhere if no firewall filters it.
Certificates: those Censys sees on the address list the names it serves. If internal or test names appear, stop publishing them; if a certificate is expired or self-signed on a public service, replace it (see the "TLS certificate" module).
Software and versions: update any outdated product with the vendor's or the distribution's security fixes; Censys infers versions and CVEs from the services' answers, so check them on the server.
If the address belongs to a CDN or shared hosting, Censys describes the provider and not your server: examine the origin address (the "Origin IP behind a CDN" module).
Check from outside with `nmap` on your own addresses (snippet below), then rerun this module: the Censys record only changes at the next pass of its probes, and the delay varies.
module.censys.fix_snippet:
# ss
sudo ss -tulpn

# PowerShell
Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Sort-Object LocalPort | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess

# nmap
nmap -Pn -sV -p- 203.0.113.10
module.censys.title: Censys
module.censys.why: Censys indexes the Internet the way attackers do: it reveals exposed services, their versions and the related certificates, even on ports nobody watches.
